scope: Metadata-only diagnostics from the full saved confirmation

interruption.decision: Interrupt only this client after the second extended unfinished call; allow queued repairs, then resume the same attempt from saved data.

limits: Observations are nested inside author invocations; do not add them as separate elapsed stages.
Function-item observation to native tool start is not an isolated measure of generation, reasoning, scheduling or network transport.
Raw argument sizes came from function_call records; no argument content or private reasoning was retained.
Usage values are the recorded last-request snapshots, not additive run totals or credit estimates.
Interrupted function output was unfinished and no payload-size claim is made for it.
Context compaction and the delays are observations, not proof of causation.
